decisions.reason: The product builds directly on the firm's operational and analytics expertise in aircraft turnaround and airport planning, allowing it to assimilate early results and improve the software.
Apron connectivity is closely related to the firm's core integration and airside operational knowledge, so the firm can effectively interpret and develop this module further.
Revenue calculation and billing lies outside the firm's existing operational and engineering knowledge, making it harder to understand early feedback and improve the product profitably.
Monitoring apron equipment leverages the firm's installed equipment experience and maintenance capabilities, providing the related knowledge needed to learn from and enhance the product.
